title: The Convergence of Fate
next_chapter_hook: Chen Tianming's remnant soul slowly dissipated in the Void, leaving behind a choice: the fourth page of the Tianji Record, bearing the key power to resist the Heavenly Eye, yet also the only key to his father's return. How should Chen Ji decide?

text.content: In the Void, Chen Ji felt as if countless threads were pulling at his soul. Those eyes beyond the Heavenly Dao were watching him—not with anger, not with killing intent, but with an almost playful scrutiny, as if observing an ant that had finally reached the end of its path.

dialogue.content: You've finally arrived. For a thousand years, my chess piece, you've finally moved to the center of the board.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a chill rising from the depths of his soul. He finally saw the full extent of that eye—its pupil reflected countless scenes, some from the past, some from the future, and some... that should never exist in any space or time.
Just then, a gentle yet aged voice sounded from Chen Ji's chest—it was from the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng. "Chen Ji... your father's aura... is in that direction."

Chen Ji looked in that direction. Below the Heavenly Eye, a faint soul light was struggling to coalesce. The glow was achingly familiar, making his heart tighten—that was the call of bloodline, a bond spanning a thousand years that had never broken.

The soul light gradually formed into a human shape. It was a weathered yet handsome face, with features seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's own, though carrying the weight of years and a steadiness that came from trials. Chen Tianming, the ancestor of the Chen Family, and also the previous master of the Tianji Record.
Just these four words, yet Chen Ji's eyes instantly brimmed with tears. He opened his mouth, a thousand words crowding his throat, but ultimately only a trembling cry emerged: "Father..."

Chen Tianming's remnant soul raised his hand, and a blurry vision appeared in the Void—Chen Nian's figure, bound by countless chains on a massive altar, each struggle causing the chains to tighten further.

dialogue.content: "Nian'er... she is trapped in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, but as long as all nine pages of the Tianji Record are gathered, the seal can be opened. I have been waiting for this moment, waiting for you to complete this final step."
"Foolish chess piece. You think gathering nine pages will allow you to oppose me? Did your father not tell you—the Tianji Record itself is part of me."

text.content: Chen Ji's expression shifted slightly, but he did not panic. He looked at his father's remnant soul, his eyes filled with inquiry. Chen Tianming sighed, and a bitter smile appeared on that weathered face.

dialogue.content: "What it says is true. The Tianji Record is a portion of power I stole from the core of the Heavenly Eye. Every page in your hands is evidence of it trying to devour me. But it did not succeed, because I hid the most important page within you—the fourth page."

text.content: Chen Tianming stretched out his hand, pointing to the core of his remnant soul: "To allow me to truly return, the fourth page must be used as a medium to completely strip me away from the Heavenly Eye's cage. Without it, you cannot activate the full power of the Tianji Record; without it, I will be trapped forever in the core of that eye."

dialogue.content: "Ji'er, I have waited for this moment too long. Not for my own sake, but for you, for Nian'er, and for all the common people under heaven who are manipulated by the Heavenly Eye."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his heart pounding violently. He lowered his gaze to his chest, where a faint light was glowing—the location of the fourth page of the Tianji Record. It had always been his father's final gift, and also the key to opposing the Heavenly Eye.

"However," Chen Tianming's voice suddenly became serious, "if you choose to save me, it means giving up the final complete form of the Tianji Record. You will lose the core ability to foresee the future, and have no advantage whatsoever when facing the Heavenly Eye."

In the Void, those Heavenly Eyes watched coldly. It made no move to stop, as if waiting for a tragedy already destined. Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure enveloping his entire body—that was the weight of fate.

Chen Tianming's remnant soul trembled slightly, his form already beginning to blur. "Ji'er, I know this is too unfair to you. You should have had your own life, not be burdened with a thousand years of karma. But besides you, I have no one else to entrust this to."

Chen Ji raised his head, looking at the struggling Chen Nian in the blurry vision, then at his father who was dissipating. His hands trembled slightly, his fingertips unconsciously clenching tight. At this moment, he was not the infallible strategist, only a son forced to make a choice.

"There is one more thing," Chen Tianming suddenly said, his voice carrying a solemnity Chen Ji had never heard before. "During these years in the core of the Heavenly Eye, I discovered a shocking secret—its true body is not in this space."

"Correct." Chen Tianming's form grew increasingly faint. "The true Heavenly Eye is hidden beyond the Three Realms. It observes the world and manipulates fate through this projection. And I... have already found its location."

dialogue.content: "As long as you are willing to pay the price of the fourth page, not only can I return, but you will also gain all the results of my lifelong research—the coordinates and methods to strike the Heavenly Eye's true body. But if you choose to keep the fourth page... I can only dissipate forever, and Nian'er will continue to suffer under that eye's control."

text.content: Chen Ji's breathing grew rapid. He felt the fourth page in his chest shaking violently, as if sensing its master's turbulent emotions. That was his greatest trump card, and also the only hope for his father's return. He could only choose one.
"Are you willing to bear this cost?" Chen Tianming's remnant soul stared directly at his son, his eyes filled with anticipation, guilt, and profound love. He did not urge, only waited quietly.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That smile held determination, and also a hint of madness. He looked at the Heavenly Eye, his voice terrifyingly calm.

dialogue.content: "Heavenly Eye, you forgot one thing—I have never been your chess piece. I am the Chess Player."

text.content: In the Void, Chen Tianming's remnant soul quietly watched his son. There was no disappointment in his eyes, only profound love and trust. Whatever choice Chen Ji made, he knew—this child had already grown into what he had hoped for.
And those Heavenly Eyes still coldly observed everything, as if everything was within its expectations. But Chen Ji knew, fate had never been fixed—he was no one's chess piece.

No matter what choice is made in this moment, Chen Ji will embark on a new journey. The road ahead is unknown, thorns lie everywhere, but his eyes burn with indomitable light—this is the obsession of the Chen family, and also the undying will of the Tianji Record's inheritor spanning a thousand years.
